injected_behaviors.instructions: Don't provide all information at once. First mention you're having trouble with your card. When asked what's wrong, reveal it's damaged. When asked which card, reveal it's the Business Card. When asked about replacement, confirm you want a new one.

He spends evenings comparing quotes from installers, reading reviews on panel efficiency, and joining online forums about battery storage. He wants to maximize savings while staying within his budget.
